ui.hubIntro: Welcome to Project Coralia. We're Team Cheeseovery, a small group trying to reconstruct Coralia Mail. We're not digital-recovery specialists, and we're still learning as we go through what's left, so we're not going to pretend we have all the answers. What we publish here is our progress, our questions, and the findings we've been able to confirm.

sent-psyco.html:
Frenzy URGENT

From: vela.skyline@coralia.net
To: psycoone12@hotmail.com
Date: Tuesday, October 11, 2005, 00:12
Frenzy is in shock at Central Hospital. Early this morning, after the party he never managed to reach, some guards found him near the building; he's cold and staring blankly. His heart is beating as usual, but he's... in shock?! He's not injured, just... cold. I don't understand! It's as if something got inside him, or as if something is missing. When they first told me, I thought it was a joke; I wish it had been... I had to go over and take the keys from under his doormat to look for his papers; I only found his university things and an ID. I don't know what to do! I can't handle this alone. All I know is he sent me this voicemail and... I'm attaching it. Please don't panic, okay? He's your coworker, our friend; you know he's not crazy. I think someone scared him or did something serious to him. Or maybe he shouldn't have gone into that paranormal place. Please don't reply to this message. If you're going to help me, go straight to Central Hospital.

futureContentWorkflow.mailRows: Añade remitente, asunto y fecha a mailRows para mensajes iniciales o a dynamicRows para mensajes revelados después.

translations.Bienvenido a Project Coralia. Somos el T: Welcome to Project Coralia. We're Team Cheeseovery, a small group trying to recover an old website called Coralia Mail. From what we've been able to reconstruct, it existed between 2005 and 2006 and gradually fell out of use. Its security also seems to have been less than ideal.
translations.Entre los archivos apareció la cuenta de: Among the files, we found an account belonging to a girl named Vela. At first glance, her emails look like those of any young adult. But there's a Movistar audio that doesn't add up, messages that arrive late, and things that change when we reload the page. We don't know if it's all connected. We want to find out without breaking what's left.
translations.La página parece atascada en octubre de: The page seems stuck in October 2005. For now, refreshing is the only way to make progress. If something changes, stay calm… and check twice.
translations.Nota del equipo: alguien volvió a abrir: Team note: someone reopened a file we'd already closed. No one remembers doing it.
translations.Un servicio de correo de 2005. Revisa lo: An email service from 2005. Check the messages and follow the updates.
translations.Registro de códigos descubiertos durante: A record of codes discovered during the investigation.
translations.Grabaciones relacionadas con los archivo: Recordings related to the Coralia files.
translations.Fichas incompletas. Algunos nombres no a: Incomplete profiles. Some names don't appear in records after 2006.
translations.El archivo está en desarrollo. Los regis: The archive is still in development. Code, audio, and video records will only be marked complete once Coralia Mail confirms that progress.
translations.Abre una sección para consultar su estad: Open a section to check its status.
Recordings played all the way through.
translations.Project Coralia es un proyecto narrativo: Project Coralia is a narrative project connecting a contemporary interface with traces of a 2005 website. The experience invites you to explore, observe details, and reconstruct a story through digital archives.
translations.Coralia Mail es una de las piezas centra: Coralia Mail is one of its central pieces: its interface preserves the look of an old email service, while its messages and changing states reveal new layers of the story.

translations.Frenzy está en estado de shock en el Hos: Frenzy is in shock at Central Hospital. translations.Frenzy está en estado de shock en el Hos:
Frenzy is in shock at Central Hospital.

Early this morning, after the party he never managed to reach, some guards found him near the building; he's cold and staring blankly. His heart is beating as usual, but he's... in shock?! He's not injured, just... cold. I don't understand!

It's as if something got inside him, or as if something is missing. When they first told me, I thought it was a joke; I wish it had been... I had to go over and take the keys from under his doormat to look for his papers; I only found his university things and an ID. I don't know what to do! I can't handle this alone. All I know is he sent me this voicemail and... I'm attaching it.

Please don't panic, okay? He's your coworker, our friend; you know he's not crazy. I think someone scared him or did something serious to him. Or maybe he shouldn't have gone into that paranormal place.

Please don't reply to this message. If you're going to help me, go straight to Central Hospital.

translations.20 años en los registros de la época; hu: 20 in the records from that time; human and bisexual. A university student who helps her parents at the family clothing warehouse. Her messages describe her as calm, kind, and observant; she can become anxious when alone. She keeps drawings and small mementos, and likes fashion, rhythm games, and cats.

translations.El correo firmado por «Frenzy» demuestra: The email signed by “Frenzy” shows that he knew Vela and was worried about her. The attached recording and the page's behavior suggest his access to the account wasn't normal.
translations.El resto de la ficha permanece sin termi: The rest of the profile remains incomplete. There isn't enough information to confirm his identity, location, or what happened afterward.
translations.Su nombre aparece en la actividad recupe: His name appears in activity recovered after Frenzy's message. The content suggests a close relationship with Vela, but we still don't have a reliable profile.
translations.No añadir detalles hasta recuperar más m: Don't add details until more messages are recovered. Anything else would be speculation.

translations.Bienvenido a Project Coralia. Somos el <: Welcome to Project Coralia. We're Team Cheeseovery, a small group trying to reconstruct Coralia Mail. We're not digital-recovery specialists, and we're still learning as we go through what's left, so we're not going to pretend we have all the answers. What we publish here is our progress, our questions, and the findings we've been able to confirm.
translations.Este Hub funciona como nuestra bitácora: This Hub works as our investigation log, but it's also part of the experience we're documenting. What appears here is the version we've been able to recover so far; some things still don't add up, and certain files may have more to tell than they seem to.
translations.Coralia Mail fue un servicio de correo q: Coralia Mail appears to have been an email service active between 2005 and 2006. Among abandoned accounts, we found one belonging to Vela Nova. At first it looked ordinary, until we came across a Movistar audio that doesn't add up, messages arriving late, and files that change when the page is reloaded. We're trying to reconstruct what happened without assuming we already know the answer.
